All test data reverted (see seed_data_creation).

minor.issue: Recipe pydantic model marks `code` as required, so the endpoint's auto-code fallback (`if not recipe.code`) is unreachable and any client omitting code gets 422. UI works only because RecipeModal sends code:''. Make it Optional[str] = ''.
Same pattern: Product.barcode is required, so the auto-barcode fallback is unreachable and omitting barcode returns 422. Make barcode optional.

Seeded recipes (rec_01) have no unit_cost/material_cost/total_estimated_cost fields because seed_data inserts them without running _recipe_costs; list endpoint does not compute on read (UI recomputes client-side so cards still show cost). Compute costs on read or backfill in seed.

A 'planned' order can be completed without ever being started (no status guard); also purchase_price of the finished product is silently overwritten with recipe unit_cost (update_cost defaults True) which mutates pricing data with no audit trail.

Only rejects when NO allowed key is present: PUT {notes:'x', items:[...]} on an approved invoice returns 200 and silently ignores items instead of 400. Consider rejecting when disallowed keys are supplied.
Still returns raw Mongo `_id` next to `id` in every payload (pre-existing, reported in iteration 6).
Return 424 while tests/backend_test.py (iteration 2) asserts 502 — pre-existing mismatch, 2 failures in the full-suite run.

ui_bugs.issue: No Escape/backdrop close handler; after pressing Escape the fixed overlay stays mounted and intercepts pointer events, blocking every click behind it (detail-tab-* clicks timed out). Only the X button closes it.

Ekstre Önizleme modal also has no Escape/backdrop close; while open it blocks the statement share bar underneath. Same missing-handler pattern as InstallmentPlanModal / RecipeModal / ProductionOrderModal / ContactTermsModal / QuoteEditModal / SurveyDetailModal / ApproveOrderModal (none register a keydown handler).
React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' still logged on contact detail / payment selects (pre-existing, reported in iteration 6).

Onay linki gönderildikten sonra teklif status 'sent' olduğu için varsayılan arşiv filtresi onu listeden gizliyor; approval-badge ('Onay bekliyor' / 'Onaylandı • ad') sadece 'Gönderilen / sonuçlanan teklifleri göster' işaretlenince görünüyor. Onay bekleyen teklifler varsayılan görünümde kalmalı.

action_items: Add Escape + backdrop close (and unmount) to InstallmentPlanModal and StatementShare print modal — the overlays currently block all clicks behind them; ideally extract a shared <Modal> wrapper for all Faz 7 modals.
Make Recipe.code and Product.barcode Optional in models.py — the server-side auto-generation fallbacks are currently dead code and any API client omitting them gets 422.
Backfill/compute recipe cost fields (unit_cost/material_cost) for seeded recipes or compute them in GET /api/production/recipes.
Guard POST /api/production/orders/{id}/complete so only 'in_production' orders can be completed, and make purchase_price overwrite explicit (update_cost default false or log a stock/cost movement).
PUT /api/invoices/{id} on a non-draft invoice should return 400 when disallowed fields (items, discounts) are sent together with notes/due_date instead of silently ignoring them.
Keep 'sent' quotes visible in the default /projects Teklifler view so the 'Onay bekliyor' badge is reachable, and disable/flag the e-mail approval channel when no mail account is configured.

Leftover test data from earlier iterations still in DB: recipe BOM-123963 (prod_01, material = klavye), contacts 'TEST Cari 7b807e6f', invoices TEST-695c7e54ed / TEST-95199632f0 / TEST-a4a68336b5, quote TKF-2026-0027 — clean up if not intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3379 lines — split into routers (invoices, banking, installments, quotes/approval, production, comm) before further growth.
pay_installment (balance branch) writes bank_transactions + bank_accounts + contacts + installments without any compensation on partial failure; same non-transactional risk as invoice payments.

_reverse_tx_effects is used for both edit and delete; it reverses invoice paid_amount too, but update_bank_transaction does not validate that a tx linked to an invoice keeps paid_amount <= grand_total after an amount increase.

complete_production_order recomputes requirements from the recipe at completion time, so a recipe edited between order creation and completion silently consumes different materials than the order preview showed — snapshot requirements on the order.
clean_doc() leaks Mongo _id in all responses (unchanged since iteration 6).

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 Faz 7 cases sequentially; full suite 175/180 pass — 2 pre-existing mail 424/502 assertions + 2 xdist-parallel installment collisions between test_iteration6 and test_iteration7)

Always run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iteration7.py after test_iteration7.py, otherwise the paid balance installment blocks re-creating a plan (400). Faz 7 scope (bank tx edit/delete, invoice edit, aging/terms, balance installments, quote approval + public page, production/recipes, categories, brute force) is fully covered; not re-tested this round: GİB lookup, print templates, barcode labels, SMS/mail settings pages (iteration 2-6).
rca_of_the_issue: The two modal defects share one root cause: Faz 7 modals render a raw `fixed inset-0` overlay div with no keydown listener and no onClick on the backdrop, so Escape does nothing and the still-mounted overlay swallows pointer events for the page beneath (Playwright reports 'intercepts pointer events'). The 422s on POST /api/production/recipes and /api/products come from required pydantic fields (code, barcode) that the handlers then try to auto-fill, making the fallback branches unreachable for any client that omits them.
